points.text: A fire at a seaside resort in Bangladesh’s Cox’s Bazar killed at least 10 people and injured nine others; children were among the dead.
Hundreds of thousands protested rising living costs and school conditions across France, where clashes, fires and looting were reported and police used tear gas in Paris.
President Donald Trump signed a waiver suspending new sanctions approved by Congress, citing U.S. national interests; Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy called the decision unfortunate.
A Mexican judge sentenced three men to 158 years in prison each for the 2024 murders of two Australian brothers and their American friend.
A crowd surge at a Durga Puja pandal in north Kolkata injured at least 25 people, with reports varying on the toll and whether deaths occurred.
